# Python Iteration Tools

*Source:* [Python Iteration Tools](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ) · 12:34 · Prof X

## 1. Iteration tools

### enumerate()

<sub>▶ [00:42](https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ?t=42)</sub>

Yields (index, item) pairs.
The index starts at zero.

```
for i, name in enumerate(names):
    print(i, name)
```

### zip()

<sub>▶ [06:40](https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ?t=400)</sub>

About zip().

```python
for a, b in zip(xs, ys):
    print(a, b)
```

**Example:** zip([1, 2], 'ab') gives (1, 'a'), (2, 'b')
